final_message: Fixed character-range formatting. String-view detection incorrectly treated ranges as strings, nested formatters skipped debug initialization, and temporary elements couldn’t bind to mutable range formatters. The fix requires genuine const string-view conversions, initializes nested formatters, and retains temporary elements as lvalues. Added regression coverage and updated documentation.
